title: Gita Chapter 15: Purushottama Yoga
author: Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 15
intro: The chapter of the Supreme Person, recited before meals in many homes. It opens with the image of the world as an upside-down peepal tree, and includes Krishna's words on the light of the sun and the digestive fire.
note: Many families recite this chapter before eating, because verse 14 speaks of the digestive fire. The text follows the commonly printed (Gita Press) reading.
